acs.text_first_line: AC1 A delivered proof moves the notice to Delivered
AC2 A refused or undeliverable proof leaves the notice Unserved
AC3 The delivery fact leaves the service once, on the S4 contract
AC4 No proof, an unknown notice or a dispatched-only notice is refused
AC5 The same proof twice writes once
AC6 The decision record is written before the notice changes
AC7 A caller without the Litigation right is refused
AC8 The notice facts show on the two screens
